content:
Use this exact provided image as the start frame and as the only composition for the entire video. Create a 18-second continuous shot from a 1980s dark fantasy feature film. Do not cut, do not reframe, do not pan, do not tilt, do not zoom, do not generate alternate angles, and do not shift to any other shot at any point. The entire scene must remain locked to this exact close-up composition only: the dark-haired woman on the left gazing upward at the large creature on the right, in the dim cave-like fantasy setting. Maintain the same framing, same angle, same distance, and same character positions throughout.

Style: practical 1980s dark fantasy film, real actors, practical creature makeup and animatronic facial movement, 35mm film grain, soft halation, low-key blue-and-amber lighting, atmospheric cave shadows, subtle mist, tactile old-film texture. No modern CGI look.

The tone is tender, romantic, sincere, and gently playful. The woman and the creature sing a soft 1980s fantasy-pop love ballad to each other about how they may not have SEEDANCE 2.5, but at least they have each other and LTX 2.3.

Keep movement minimal and natural so the locked composition remains stable: subtle blinking, breathing, tiny head tilts, emotional eye contact, gentle mouth movement synchronized clearly to the lyrics. The woman may make only a very small affectionate movement, such as slightly leaning closer or softly lifting her hand within frame. The creature responds with delicate practical facial motion and slight affectionate leaning. No big gestures, no blocking changes, no repositioning that breaks the shot.

0–5 sec: The woman sings softly and lovingly:
♪ “We may not have Seedance two point five tonight…” ♪

5–10 sec: The creature answers in a deep, warm, tender singing voice:
♪ “But with L T X two point three, everything feels right…” ♪

10–18 sec: They sing together in harmony:
♪ “If we have each other, we already have enough…” ♪

Music: soft 1980s fantasy-pop ballad, warm analog synth pads, electric piano, light drums, romantic melody, dreamy emotional atmosphere.

Critical instruction: the video must remain on this exact image composition only for the entire 16 seconds. No cutaways, no reverse shots, no inserts, no montage, no alternate view, no wider shot, no closer shot, no camera move, no shot change of any kind.

保持动作最小化和自然，以便锁定的构图保持稳定：细微的眨眼、呼吸、微小的头部倾斜、情感的眼神交流、与歌词清晰同步的温柔嘴部动作。女人只能做一个非常小的亲昵动作，比如在画面内稍微靠近或轻轻抬起她的手。生物以细腻的实用面部动作和轻微的亲昵倾斜回应。没有大动作，没有阻挡变化，没有打破镜头的重新定位。
